title: Coin Catcher
brief: Drag a cart sideways to catch falling coins in waves that speed up. Collect 25 to win; each missed coin costs one of three lives.

title: Magnet Run
brief: Move around a grid picking coins that respawn in empty cells; a magnet makes you big for six seconds, bombs cost a life. Reach 15 coins within 40 seconds.

title: Gem Dash
brief: Catch green gems and rubies worth three while a level ramps up, adding ruby makers and bombs. Reach 40 points before the three lives run out.

title: Speed Boots
brief: Steer a runner across a wide arena collecting 12 coins within 45 seconds; picking up the boots doubles your speed for five seconds, a patrolling sentry sends you back to the start.

title: Whack the Gold
brief: Tap gold nuggets that appear in empty grid cells before they crumble and avoid tapping rocks. Reach 20 gold; three mistakes end the run.

title: Firefly Jar
brief: Move a jar to catch wandering fireflies; three catches in a row give a bonus, the streak decays over time, and a moth chases the jar. Catch 30 before losing three lives.

title: Orchard Pick
brief: A tree drifts along the top dropping apples and wormy fruit; slide the basket to catch apples and dodge worms. Fill it with 18 apples before three worm hits.

title: Treasure Cave
brief: Three cave levels: gather enough gems to open the gate, dodge patrolling bats and climb the ladder, then catch falling coins and avoid rocks on the last level to reach 20 treasure.

title: Star Tower
brief: Catch falling stars with a cart; milestones unlock a bigger cart, golden stars worth three and then a comet rain. Reach 50 stars before the comets use up three lives.

title: Grid Munch
brief: Steer a muncher step by step with the d-pad to eat 12 pellets that respawn in empty cells while a ghost chases and gets faster. Two hits end the game.

title: Balloon Pop
brief: Tap rising balloons for points; the gold ones are worth five but shrink quickly. Pop 30 before six balloons escape through the top.
